## 2. Broad ruler-period reconnaissance (pre-lens notes)

Key recurring 2000 facts I located across multiple independent sources:

- **Kim Jong-Il's formal position in 2000:** WPK General Secretary (since October 1997) and Chairman of the National Defense Commission (since 1993, constitutionally designated "supreme leader of the state" by the 1998 revision). He was not yet "President" — that title was held in perpetuity by his father Kim Il-Sung as "Eternal President." (Reuters "Q+A — Why did North Korea change its constitution?"; KBS World profile; CFR backgrounder; HRNK Insider on authority.)
- **Songun ("military-first") doctrine:** Codified in joint New Year editorials from January 1999 and elaborated in January 2000 — at which point the regime began calling it "military-first politics" as an organizing ideology. (Nautilus Institute Policy Forum 05-32A; Brookings; Wikipedia "Songun".)
- **Inter-Korean summit, June 13–15, 2000, Pyongyang:** Kim Jong-Il met South Korean President Kim Dae-jung (Nobel Peace Prize 2000) in the first ever inter-Korean summit, producing the June 15 North–South Joint Declaration. (Wikipedia "2000 inter-Korean summit"; KBS World; Arms Control Association chronology.)
- **October 2000:** Highest-level U.S.–DPRK contacts ever — Vice Marshal Jo Myong-rok visited Washington; Secretary of State Madeleine Albright met Kim Jong-Il in Pyongyang on October 23–24, 2000, a six-plus-hour meeting. (Brookings; CNN; NYT 2018; NCNK Joint Communiqué.)

- **July 2000:** Kim Jong-Il met Putin; reported willingness to end missile program in exchange for satellite-launch assistance. (Arms Control Association chronology.)

- **Public-Distribution System still operating at <100% of need; private markets/jangmadang had become essential survival mechanism.** (HRW 2006; ScienceDirect.)
